output.summary: Deciduous tree native to central and eastern North America, mostly in riverside habitats. Its grey-black bark is deeply furrowed into diamond-like patterns, while its round fruits contain exceptionally hard, corrugated nuts. The kernels are edible, and spring sap can be drunk or concentrated into syrup or sugar.
output.edibilityNote: The kernels are eaten in many dishes; spring sap may be drunk or concentrated into syrup or sugar.
